subjectKind.description: The principal kind the app serves and verifies (for example "customer"). Any other kind but anonymous acts for subjects. A lowercase word, since it is also an audit detail key.

delegateKind.description: The app's word for a party who acts for subjects (for example "agent"), as the harness's errors name one. Default "delegate".

factorSlots.description: The slots collected on voice for a step-up (for example accountId, dob), asked in this order. Each slot id is also the name of the verify tool's param that carries its value.

verifyTool.description: The tool that verifies the factors (for example verifyCustomer).

codeTool.description: The tool that checks the one-time code (for example verifyCode).

sendCodeTool.description: The tool that texts the one-time code.

failedPromptId.description: The prompt (an id in prompts.yaml) said before the factors are asked again after a failed match. Default "identity_failed".

description: identity.yaml: how a caller proves who they are. Leave the file out for an app that verifies no one.
